name: GS Engineering & Construction Corporation
summary: GS Engineering & Construction Corporation engages in the civil works and construction, sales of new houses, repairs and maintenance, overseas general construction, and technology consultation activities in South Korea and internationally. The company operates through Architectural & Housing Construction, Development & New Business, Plant Construction, Infra Works, Prefab, Inima, and Others segments. The Architectural & Housing Construction segment builds and markets office building, factory, apartment and others. The Development & New Business engages in overseas development projects.
